tools.name: check_stack_drift
tools.description: Read-only audit of a package.json, requirements.txt, or .mcp.json configuration string against 258 live AI Agent SDKs and MCP servers. Flags breaking major version deltas, unpinned @latest MCP servers, and outdated dependencies with exact pin commands. Requires no authentication and returns a struct

tools.name: get_package_stability
tools.description: Read-only lookup of live npm or PyPI version, publish timestamp, 90-day release velocity, stability score (0-100), MCP tools/list schema drift risk, and before/after migration code for a single AI Agent SDK or MCP server. Prefer this over check_stack_drift when inspecting one specific package by nam

tools.name: list_volatile_packages
tools.description: Read-only query that lists the fastest-changing or highest schema-drift-risk AI Agent SDKs and MCP servers from the live AgentBreakWatch telemetry index, sorted descending by 90-day release velocity. Supports filtering by kind ('sdk', 'mcp', 'all'), category hub slug, and result limit (1-50).

tools.name: get_archived_mcp_replacements
tools.description: Read-only lookup returning the complete migration matrix for archived or frozen @modelcontextprotocol/server-* reference packages and their official 2026 vendor-maintained replacements. Takes no parameters and requires no authentication.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_stack_drift" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
